summary: Zebuxoruk’s Prison is the deepest metaphysical lock within the Void. It was constructed by the gods to bind the would‑be god of knowledge outside time, reality, and planar influence.
history: Forged during the first planar war when Zebuxoruk sought forbidden knowledge.
The gods created temporal anchors, eternity chains, and void pressure locks to restrain him.
The prison was sealed within the Void to prevent mortals or immortals from reaching it.
Over time, the Void itself formed guardians and entities around the prison’s structure.
